name: evestack-monorepo
description: A fully free, self-hosted distribution of the eve agent framework.

scripts.test: node contract/run.mjs && ls contract/lib/*.test.mjs > /dev/null && node --test 'contract/lib/*.test.mjs' && ls contract/runtime/lib/*.test.mjs > /dev/null && node --test 'contract/runtime/lib/*.test.mjs' && pnpm -r --if-present test
